dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh? Don't you feel cold out here?

dialogues.speaker: Pweza
dialogues.text: A little bit, yeah! But I just did a few squats over there, so I'm feeling much better now.

dialogues.speaker: Pweza
dialogues.text: If you're cold, just move around to get your blood pumping.

dialogues.speaker: Pweza
dialogues.text: Next time you feel a chill, give it a shot!
